verdict.rationale: Elicit documents an API (and MCP server) explicitly for running its search/report/systematic-review capabilities 'from your own code, scripts, and workflows,' which supports headless/automated use outside the UI. However, there's no explicit CI/pipeline example, and API access appears gated as a paid plan feature rather than a fully documented automation-first workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples or tutorials, rate-limit/auth details for unattended use, and independent confirmation that the API works reliably in automated pipelines.
